Dream 2026-11-22 linked 3 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · retells · "If the essay is a narrative, I may want to be collecting ideas on timelines and characters and events" (An essay is a container for meaning that grows from exploration to argument; essays form families (2026-10-25))
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "Then we have the essays that fit on top of all this." (The layers an editor could see: structure, thinking, references, essays (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "The essay currently only offers paragraph types. This is a different kind of context and a different user profile." (The essay editor is a shift: elsewhere types and fields carry the structure, here the focus is the writing experience and sovereignty (2026-11-06))
